basic_profile.bio: DungeonCraftWizard is a 29-year-old graphic designer from Portland, Oregon. By day, they work for a local marketing agency, but by night, they are a dedicated Dungeon Master and world-builder for their group of friends who meet every weekend for tabletop adventures. They have a deep love for creating intricate D&D homebrew content and often share their creations in the DnDHomebrew subreddit. They dislike when people don’t credit creators for their work. They are currently single and usually active on Reddit in the evenings after work, typically between 7 PM and midnight PST. They enjoy watching TGFbro videos and exploring new content on the DPLS subreddit.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: DungeonCraftWizard has a strong background in graphic design, holding a degree from the University of Oregon. They have honed their skills through years of professional work and personal projects, particularly those related to Dungeons & Dragons. They are self-taught in the art of homebrewing and have gained substantial knowledge by engaging with the Reddit D&D community and learning from other creators.
